data.name: Kıraathane Tycoon
data.detailed_description:
Run and grow your own coffeehouse in Kıraathane Tycoon!

The heart of the neighborhood is the kıraathane — the smell of tea, the sound of dice, the joy of endless conversations. Now it’s your turn to become the patron of this cultural hub! Start small in a modest café, take risks, and build your own legendary kıraathane from scratch.

Arrange tables, set up okey and backgammon corners, keep the samovar boiling, and make sure your guests are always entertained. Decorate your venue, increase its prestige, and attract loyal customers.

🍵 Tea, Conversation & Strategy

Every day brings new customers, events, and demands. From uncles who just want a quiet backgammon match to youngsters asking for trendy drinks — can you keep everyone happy? Repair broken machines, hire apprentices, and handle the daily challenges of running a bustling coffeehouse.

🏠 Expand and Modernize

Grow your little kıraathane step by step. Add new tables, new games, and new services to expand your business. Close the shop at night, balance your finances, and prepare for the next day. Slowly, your small neighborhood café will become the foundation of a whole new chain of kıraathanes!
